description: Platform video player: custom, keyboard-accessible controls (shadow DOM) over a light-DOM <video>, with optional playlist

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Start playing on first connect (subject to browser autoplay policy). Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (which also cancels a native autoplay on the inner video) and never re-run when the player is moved/reconnected

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Single video: sets the native video.loop. Playlist: after the last track, wrap to the first

attributes.name: shuffle
attributes.description: Playlist: advance to a random other track when one ends

attributes.name: muted
attributes.description: Start muted. Afterwards reflects the inner video.muted (mute button, M key, an authored <video muted> or script)

attributes.name: captions
attributes.description: Start with the first captions/subtitles track showing. Afterwards reflects whether captions are showing

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Reflected playback state, derived from the media element (also on reconnect)

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Set while the overlay controls are visible; removed by the auto-hide timer during playback (never while focus is inside the controls). Not the native controls attribute

attributes.name: data-fullscreen
attributes.description: Set while THIS player (or its video) is the fullscreen element

attributes.name: data-label-player
attributes.description: Host accessible name (role=group) unless aria-label/aria-labelledby is authored

attributes.name: data-label-mute
attributes.description: Mute toggle (state is carried by aria-pressed)

attributes.name: data-label-speed
attributes.description: Speed button; {rate} is the localized rate, e.g. "1.5x"

attributes.name: data-label-exit-fullscreen
attributes.description: Fullscreen button while this player is fullscreen

attributes.name: data-label-time-of
attributes.description: Seek slider aria-valuetext; {current}/{duration} are locale clock times, e.g. "0:05 of 3:20"

properties.name: src
properties.description: Get/set the inner <video> source. Setting loads it and fires video-player:src-changed

events.name: video-player:ended
events.description: A video played to the end

events.name: video-player:track-change
events.description: A playlist track was activated (click or auto-advance)

events.name: video-player:fullscreen
events.description: This player entered or left fullscreen

events.name: video-player:captions
events.description: Captions toggled by the button or C key

childAttributes.name: controls
childAttributes.description: Native controls for the no-JS fallback. Removed while the component is upgraded, restored when it disconnects

childAttributes.name: data-video-active
childAttributes.description: The loaded playlist track. Author sets the initial one; the component moves it

childAttributes.name: data-video-played
childAttributes.description: Set by the component when the track plays to the end

childAttributes.name: data-poster
childAttributes.description: Playlist link: poster image to show for that track

childAttributes.name: data-captions
childAttributes.description: Playlist link: WebVTT captions URL; the component swaps in a captions <track> (marked data-dynamic) for that track

structure.description: The native video element (light DOM), with <source>/<track> children and fallback content
Optional playlist (usually inside <details>): one <li> per video with an <a href> to the file

cssProperties.name: --video-player-accent
cssProperties.description: Progress fill, slider thumbs and focus ring fallback

parts.name: play-overlay
parts.description: Big centered play button (shown idle/ended; inert otherwise)

parts.name: captions-button
parts.description: Captions toggle (hidden without a captions/subtitles track)
